snippet.title: 【Now Available! 】FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～
snippet.description:
FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ Now Available !
Join Shirakami Fubuki to uncover the mysteries of Holoearth! 🦊🌽
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446990 🎮

You will take control of Shirakami Fubuki, one of the Kami residing in Yamato.
Wield her trusty blade Murasamemaru, perform swift swordplay, dash at high speed, and execute wall jumps with ease. Cut down the Ayakashi blocking your way and restore balance to Holoearth!

※ This game is inspired by the world of Hololive Alternative teaser PVs, manga, and other works. Some content may differ from the official setting.
――――――――――
[Developer] PEPOSOFT
Official Website: http://www.peposoft.com/
Official X: https://x.com/peposoft (@peposoft)

[Publisher] Phoenixx Inc.
Official Website: https://phoenixx.ne.jp/
Official X: https://x.com/Phoenixx_Inc (@Phoenixx_Inc)
Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PhoenixxGames
